listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Geography is the study of our EARTH - the land, water, and people.
OUR WORLD:
Our planet has 7 CONTINENTS (large land areas):
1. Asia (largest - includes Vietnam!)
2. Africa
3. North America
4. South America
5. Antarctica (coldest)
6. Europe
7. Australia/Oceania (smallest)
Our planet has 5 OCEANS (large water areas):
1. Pacific Ocean (largest)
2. Atlantic Ocean
3. Indian Ocean
4. Southern Ocean
5. Arctic Ocean (smallest, coldest)
MAPS show a flat picture of Earth.
GLOBES show the round shape of Earth.
Vietnam is in:
- Continent: Asia
- Region: Southeast Asia
- Near: Pacific Ocean (East Sea/South China Sea)
Where are you in the world?
Geography Vocabulary:
dictation: Geography is the study of our EARTH - the land, water, and people.

OUR WORLD:
Our planet has 7 CONTINENTS (large land areas):
1.
